Long-term use of PPIs may be associated with potential side effects, including nutrient deficiencies and an increased risk of certain infections.

It is available in both prescription and over-the-counter forms and is typically taken once daily. Common side effects may include headache, diarrhea, and abdominal pain, although many people do not experience significant side effects. It is important to follow the prescribed dosage and duration of treatment to ensure effectiveness and minimize potential side effects.
